overview.description: The State Street SPDR Portfolio Nasdaq 100 ETF (QNDX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ 100 index, a modified-market-cap-weighted index of 100 NASDAQ-listed stocks. QNDX was launched on Jun 23, 2026 and is issued by State Street.
